comparison.objective: Stack plates until a red stop signal, then cease work, safely set down any held plate, and clear the arms.
comparison.physical_skill: Plate handling plus perception of and response to a dynamic stop cue.
comparison.success_condition: After the alarm, no more plates reach the shelf, any held plate is placed elsewhere, and the arms clear the area; numeric timing is absent.
comparison.reason: The core ability is safe interruption of an ongoing task, unrelated to precision tang break-off and physical recovery.
